intro: Every photo below is our own work in the Indianapolis metro — no stock imagery. You will see broom-finish driveways, stamped and coloured patios, exposed aggregate, curved walkways and asphalt, alongside a before shot of the kind of failed slab we get called out to replace. Concrete is unforgiving: the edges, the joint layout and the transitions are where you can see whether someone took their time. Have a look, and then ask us about your own project.
